# netactuate_iptransit_services (Data Source)

Reads Iptransit Services visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_iptransit_services" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `service_id` (Number) Optional service ID filter sent to endpoints that accept a service_id query parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `services` (List of Object) IP transit services returned by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))
